name: forge
description: An AI pair programmer in a real editor: describe a change, watch it edit your Next.js files, and run the app live in the browser.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.e2e: npm run build --prefix frontend && playwright test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
